name: useGeminiLive
chipBadge: Gemini Live · WebSocket Duplex · Multimodal Camera
summary: Bidirectional streaming of text, microphone audio chunks and camera frames with the Gemini Live API over a WebSocket, with tool calls routed through a capability adapter you supply.
plain: Streams text, audio chunks and camera frames to Gemini in the cloud over a WebSocket and shows the transcript the model sends back. Model tool calls run only against the capabilities adapter you pass to connect.
description: Opens a WebSocket to the Gemini Live API (BidiGenerateContent). You supply the session's trace context and capability adapter to connect(); the API key comes from run.apiKey or the stored key. sendAudioChunk, sendImageChunk and sendVideoFrame forward base64 PCM audio and JPEG frames as realtime input, and sendText and sendMultimodalTurn send client turns. The hook does not capture audio or decode and play the model's audio: isSpeaking means audio parts from the model are arriving, and the audio bytes themselves are not played or exposed. isListening and isStreamingMedia are set when a chunk is sent and clear 2 s after the last one. Model tool calls are validated and executed through runTool against the adapter's tools; each call is a network round trip plus the tool's own execution time. The default model is the DEFAULT_LIVE_MODEL constant (currently 'models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp'); config.model overrides it.

params.name: config
params.desc: Optional. model (default DEFAULT_LIVE_MODEL), voiceName (one of 'Puck', 'Charon', 'Kore', 'Fenrir', 'Aoede'; default 'Aoede'), systemInstruction, and thinkingBudget (tokens; thinkingConfig is only sent when it is a non-zero number). Capabilities are not part of config: pass them to connect().

returns.name: isConnected
returns.desc: Whether the WebSocket session to Gemini Live is active and ready.

returns.name: isStreaming
returns.desc: Whether the model is actively streaming an audio or text response.

returns.name: isSpeaking
returns.desc: Whether audio parts from the model are arriving. The hook does not play audio, so this does not mean sound is coming out of the device.

returns.name: isListening
returns.desc: True after an audio chunk was sent and clears 2 seconds after the last one (or on disconnect).

returns.name: isStreamingMedia
returns.desc: True after an image or video frame was sent and clears 2 seconds after the last one (or on disconnect).

returns.name: currentThinking
returns.desc: Latest reasoning thoughts emitted by the model during extended thinking.

returns.name: activeToolCalls
returns.desc: Real-time hardware tool invocations executed during the session.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if connection or streaming protocol encountered a failure.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: 'hardware' while the WebSocket session is connected, 'unavailable' otherwise. It records that the cloud session is open, not that device hardware is involved.

returns.name: connect
returns.desc: Opens the Live session. run.context (a TraceContext) and run.capabilityAdapter (a CapabilityAdapter) are required; run.apiKey, run.sink and run.redaction are optional. Resolves with status 'connected', 'unavailable' (for example no API key: reason 'gemini_api_key_unavailable'), 'error' or 'cancelled', plus a reason when it did not connect.

returns.name: disconnect
returns.desc: Closes the active live streaming session.

returns.name: sendText
returns.desc: Sends a text prompt through the live duplex session.

returns.name: sendAudioChunk
returns.desc: Streams a base64 PCM audio chunk from the microphone array.

returns.name: sendImageChunk
returns.desc: Streams a base64 camera image or video frame into the real-time multimodal live session.

returns.name: sendVideoFrame
returns.desc: Streams a continuous camera video frame (JPEG base64) into the real-time live session.

returns.name: sendMultimodalTurn
returns.type: (text: string, images?: Array<{ data: string; mimeType?: string }>) => void
returns.desc: Sends a multimodal user turn containing both text and image attachments.

returns.name: context
returns.desc: Trace context of the current session, or null before connect() has been called.

returns.name: clearTranscript
returns.desc: Clears the transcript and active tool calls.

actions.name: connect(run)
actions.desc: Opens the Live WebSocket session with the trace context and capability adapter for this session.

inputs.name: run
inputs.desc: { context: TraceContext; capabilityAdapter: CapabilityAdapter; apiKey?: string; sink?: ObservabilitySink; redaction?: RedactionPolicy }. The adapter defines which tools the model may call; tools it does not list are not offered.

actions.output: Resolves with { status: 'connected' | 'unavailable' | 'error' | 'cancelled', context, reason? }. Check status before sending.

actions.name: sendText(text)
actions.desc: Sends a text message to the live session.

actions.name: sendAudioChunk(pcmBase64)
actions.desc: Sends a PCM audio packet to the live session.

actions.name: sendImageChunk(base64Data, mimeType)
actions.desc: Streams a base64 camera frame into the live multimodal session.

actions.name: sendVideoFrame(base64Jpeg)
actions.desc: Streams a continuous camera video frame into the live session.

actions.name: sendMultimodalTurn(text, images)
actions.desc: Sends a user turn with both text and image attachments.
actions.type: (text: string, images?: Array<{ data: string; mimeType?: string }>) => void

actions.name: clearTranscript()
actions.desc: Clears conversation history and active tool calls.

agentNote: connect() needs a trace context and a capability adapter; an adapter with no tools is valid. Check the returned status. The hook does not play the model's audio and has no interrupt action; end a session with disconnect().
